afrexai-api-architect 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a comprehensive methodology for the full API lifecycle: design, build, test, document, secure, deploy, monitor, and version APIs.
- Clear best practices for RESTful resource modeling, naming conventions, and HTTP method/status code decisions.
- Standardizes API response formats, pagination, filtering, sorting, and field selection patterns.
- Provides templates and checklists for OpenAPI specification generation and documentation.
- Guides on test suite coverage (unit, integration, contract, load) as well as production debugging, monitoring, and versioning.
